summary: CLIRUN-1-2 wires the pilot local_cli capability (gog/sheets) to the capability_run structured tool built in CLIRUN-1-1 and adds agent operating guidance to prefer the structured tool over shelling the CLI. The RunCommand projection stays working (retirement is CLIRUN-1-3), so no capability is stranded.
gaps: The agent must actually discover and use capability_run, not keep shelling out - guidance is load-bearing.
The gog capability's executableHash must be present so invocation-time verification passes (CLIRUN-1-1 fails closed without it).
Retiring the RunCommand projection here (instead of 1-3) would strand the capability before the path is proven.
resolutions: Add operating guidance (the runtime prompt/capability guidance surface) telling the agent to prefer capability_run for granted local CLI capabilities; keep it concrete.
Ensure the pilot capability definition carries executablePath + executableHash; document how an operator pins the hash.
Keep the RunCommand projection intact in this task; cutover is CLIRUN-1-3 and depends on this being proven first.
